comment: Manual waivers for §24 criteria with zero validation edges. Each entry: {"criterion": <int 1-414>, "reason": <non-empty>, "added_by": <name>, "added": "YYYY-MM-DD", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. Waivers can only suppress the unmapped verdict — never structural defects (spec §24.4 rule 4 prohibits waiving deleted/renamed criteria). Stale or expired waivers are reported by `validator trace --strict`.
